title: Deák Ferenc és a Húsvéti cikk (Ferenc Deák's Compromise)
grammar: Concessive Connectors, Purpose Clauses & Dual Constitutional Register

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say who Ferenc Deák was and what the Easter Article of 1865 offered.
I can use azért, hogy to say why someone did something.
I can name the Pragmatic Sanction and the basis for negotiation when asked about 1867.
I can read a short text about Deák and answer questions about it.
